subtitle: Inspect workflow runs, runtime journals, and investigation and planning evidence. Execution remains outside the console.
workspaceBody: Select a recorded run to inspect its current state and evidence. Only server-permitted transitions can be requested.
sampleTitle: Synthetic preview. No live requests or actions.
sampleBody: These examples illustrate workflow state and retained evidence. They are not operational evidence and cannot request transitions.
viewPurpose: Principal-scoped workflow Process snapshots, step requirements, and runtime-rechecked transition requests.
controlBody: The Operator API scopes this view to the signed-in principal and current Process revision. Every request is rechecked by the workflow runtime.
controlUnavailable: Authoritative Process transition state is unavailable. No transition can be requested.
transitionConfirm: Request {transition}? The runtime will recheck current state and authority.
transitionAccepted: Request {proposalId} was accepted for runtime review. Acceptance is not operational success; refresh until authoritative state changes.
noPermittedTransitions: No operator transition is permitted from the current authoritative state.
